contests.title: Laurens County schools — senior homestead exemption

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from Laurens County school district ad valorem taxes for educational purposes in the amount of the full assessed value of the homestead for residents of that school district who are 80 years of age or older?

measures.questionText: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from Laurens County school district ad valorem taxes for educational purposes in the amount of the full assessed value of the homestead for residents of that school district who are 80 years of age or older?

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from Laurens County school district ad valorem taxes for educational purposes in the amount of the full assessed value of the homestead for residents of that school district who are 80 years of age or older?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Exempts the full assessed value of a qualifying homestead from Laurens County school-district property taxes, including school bond taxes, beginning January 1, 2027 if voters approve. The resident must be at least 80 on January 1 of the application year, and the homestead may include no more than five contiguous acres. The exemption replaces other homestead exemptions for these school taxes and does not apply to state, county, city or independent-school-district property taxes. The resident or an agent must apply to the county tax commissioner; the exemption then renews while the home remains the resident’s homestead, and recipients must report loss of eligibility.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the full school-tax homestead exemption for qualifying residents age 80 or older.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed school-tax homestead exemption.
